verdict.rationale: Namecheap's first-party Go SDK documents availability checks and a charge-bearing domain registration call against its XML API, and a sandbox endpoint exists for safe script testing. The evidence does not show documented calls for setting registrant contacts or nameservers; the Terraform provider covers DNS records, not registrar nameservers. missing for 10: documented contact-setting calls, documented nameserver-setting calls, end-to-end registration docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register a domain end to end via the API — purchase, contacts, and nameservers in documented calls, so registration can be part of a deploy script

citations.quote: CreateWithContext(ctx, args) | Register a new domain (charge-bearing)
CheckWithContext(ctx, domains...) | Check availability of one or more domains
